# Dario Benes

> Dario Benes is a finance student at Florida Gulf Coast University (May 2027) and Senior Portfolio Manager of the FGCU Eagle Fund, a $1.2M student managed fund. His focus is credit: distressed and high yield, municipal and corporate, plus quantitative and factor investing. He is based in Naples, Florida.

## Roles
- Senior Portfolio Manager, FGCU Eagle Fund (student managed investment fund, $1.2M), Fort Myers, FL: Aug 2025 to present. Contributed to 230 bps of S&P 500 outperformance in 2025; built a quantitative screening framework on the Bloomberg Terminal combining factor signals with sector-lead fundamental research.
- Fixed Income Analyst, Birch Creek Capital (a Philadelphia RIA), Philadelphia, PA: Jul 2026 to Nov 2026 (past role). Researched distressed and high yield municipal credits for a Philadelphia RIA, analyzing EMMA continuing disclosures (annual, audited, and quarterly financials) to feed the PM’s buy and no buy decisions. Joined creditor and investor calls on covered credits, including senior living and education issuers. Built AI assisted disclosure extraction workflows in Excel, cutting reviewer error rates and turnaround time.
- Founder, DB-Quant: Aug 2024 to present. Multi-factor equity model in Python (value, quality, momentum, low volatility) with a research and backtesting pipeline.
- Founder and President, FGCU Business Ethics Society: Aug 2025 to present. Built a team that competed at three national business ethics competitions.
- Founder and President, FGCU Alternative Investing Club: Aug 2026 to present. FGCU's first alternatives club.

## Education and credentials
- BS Financial Analysis and Management, Florida Gulf Coast University, Lutgert College of Business, May 2027. Minor in Economics. 4.0 business GPA.
- CFA Level I candidate (November 2026). SIE passed. Anthropic Claude certifications (AI for Builders, Claude API). Autodesk Certified.
- Tools: Bloomberg Terminal, Python, Excel. Languages: English, native German.

## Stock pitches
- [Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ: NFLX) long pitch](https://dariobenes.com/pitches/netflix): Dario Benes pitched Netflix (NASDAQ: NFLX) as a long at the FGCU Eagle Fund Fall 2026 stock pitch competition, where his team took 2nd place. The recommendation: a $63.42 entry price, a $76.96 probability-weighted target price, 21.3% upside, and about 2.1 to 1 upside to downside. Full deck: https://dariobenes.com/assets/decks/nflx-pitch.pdf
- [The TJX Companies, Inc. (NYSE: TJX) long pitch](https://dariobenes.com/pitches/tjx): Dario Benes pitched The TJX Companies (NYSE: TJX) as a long at the FGCU Eagle Fund Fall 2026 stock pitch competition. The recommendation: a $138.72 entry price, a $152.84 probability-weighted target price, 11.7% upside and an 11.2% three-year IRR. The Eagle Fund bought a starter position at $146.72. Full deck: https://dariobenes.com/assets/decks/tjx-pitch.pdf
- [Verizon Communications Inc. (NYSE: VZ) long pitch](https://dariobenes.com/pitches/verizon): Dario Benes pitched Verizon Communications (NYSE: VZ) as a long at the FGCU Eagle Fund Spring 2026 stock pitch competition. The recommendation: a $44.00 entry price, a $58.04 blended target price, 31.9% upside and a 14.7% three-year IRR. Full deck: https://dariobenes.com/assets/decks/Eagle_Fund_Long_VZ_.pdf
- [Sprouts Farmers Market, Inc. (NASDAQ: SFM) long pitch](https://dariobenes.com/pitches/sprouts): Dario Benes pitched Sprouts Farmers Market (NASDAQ: SFM) as a long at the FGCU Eagle Fund on December 4, 2025. The recommendation: a $118.13 price target against a $79.81 last close, about 48% upside. Full deck: https://dariobenes.com/assets/decks/Eagle_Fund_Long_SFM.pdf

## Ethics cases
- [The Hermosa Project: South32’s Social License to Operate](https://dariobenes.com/ethics/hermosa-south32): Dario Benes and Nicholas Colbert, team Stop and Zinc from Florida Gulf Coast University, advised South32’s board on its Hermosa mine at the 2026 Collegiate Ethics Case Competition, hosted by the Center for Leadership Ethics at the University of Arizona. Their recommendation: continue Hermosa with four binding commitments costing US$203M in present value. FGCU later asked Dario to present the case to the Comptroller during his campus visit. Full deck: https://dariobenes.com/assets/decks/cecc-hermosa-2026.pdf
- [The Price of Access: Biometrics and Financial Inclusion](https://dariobenes.com/ethics/price-of-access): Dario Benes and team Fine Print Partners from the FGCU Business Ethics Society presented The Price of Access to the board of Access Now, a nonprofit digital rights organization, at the IBESCC national business ethics competition. The case asked whether biometric identity systems expand access to finance or create permanent risks for the people they were built to include. Full deck: https://dariobenes.com/assets/decks/IBESCC_The_Price_of_Access.pdf
- [Sustainable Aviation Fuels: The Gap Between a 10% Promise and the Supply](https://dariobenes.com/ethics/sustainable-aviation-fuels): Dario Benes, with Ashley Fearday and Emalee Postma of the FGCU Business Ethics Society, presented a case on sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) at the Stetson national business ethics competition. The case weighed Delta Air Lines’ goal of replacing 10% of its fossil jet fuel with SAF by the end of 2030 against the supply that exists to meet it. Full deck: https://dariobenes.com/assets/decks/Stetson_Sustainable_Aviation_Fuels.pdf
